indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX booking_active_overlap ON public.bookings USING gist (provider_id, tsrange((date + start_time), (date + end_time), '[)'::text)) WHERE (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['booked'::character varying, 'confirmed'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying])::text[])) OR (((status)::text = 'pending'::text) AND ((payment_method)::text = 'cod'::text)))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_pkey ON public.bookings USING btree (booking_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_geom_gist ON public.bookings USING gist (geom)
CREATE INDEX idx_users_geom_gist ON public.users USING gist (geom)
CREATE INDEX ix_bookings_booking_id ON public.bookings USING btree (booking_id)

CREATE INDEX ix_bookings_provider_active_slots ON public.bookings USING btree (provider_id, date, start_time) WHERE ((status)::text <> ALL ((ARRAY['cancelled'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying])::text[]))
CREATE INDEX ix_bookings_provider_date ON public.bookings USING btree (provider_id, date)
CREATE INDEX ix_bookings_razorpay_order_id ON public.bookings USING btree (razorpay_order_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_bookings_status ON public.bookings USING btree (status)
CREATE INDEX ix_bookings_user_id ON public.bookings USING btree (user_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_users_custom_id ON public.users USING btree (custom_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_users_lat_lng ON public.users USING btree (lat, lng)
CREATE INDEX ix_users_role ON public.users USING btree (role)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_custom_id_key1 ON public.users USING btree (custom_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_key1 ON public.users USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey1 ON public.users USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_booking_order ON public.bookings USING btree (razorpay_order_id) WHERE (razorpay_order_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_booking_payment ON public.bookings USING btree (razorpay_payment_id) WHERE (razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL)
